tagline.en: An English teacher who built China's biggest online marketplace, fell from favour, and came back quietly
tagline.zh: 从英语老师到中国最大电商的创始人，经历跌落，又低调归来

label.zh: 阿里巴巴上市前股权 + 早期积蓄（估算）

label.en: Ant Group economic interest (private, about 8.8%; estimate)
label.zh: 蚂蚁集团经济权益（未上市，约 8.8%，估算）

label.en: Other wealth (cash from share sales, Yunfeng Capital and other holdings; estimate)
label.zh: 其他财富（售股所得现金、云锋基金及其他资产，估算）

t.en: Hangzhou boyhood
t.zh: 杭州少年

desc.en: Grows up in Hangzhou, learns English from tourists, fails the entrance exam twice and gets into a teachers' college
desc.zh: 在杭州长大，跟外国游客学英语，两次高考落榜后考进师范学院

t.en: English teacher
t.zh: 英语老师

desc.en: Teaches English, discovers the internet on a trip to the United States and starts China Pages
desc.zh: 教英语，在一次赴美行程中接触互联网，创办中国黄页

t.en: Alibaba's start
t.zh: 创办阿里

desc.en: Founds Alibaba with 17 partners, raises money from Goldman and SoftBank, launches Taobao and Alipay and outlasts eBay
desc.zh: 与 17 位伙伴创办阿里巴巴，拿到高盛和软银的投资，推出淘宝和支付宝，熬走 eBay

t.en: Building the empire
t.zh: 帝国成形

desc.en: A first listing in Hong Kong, Singles' Day, the Alipay dispute, the Yahoo buyback and the handover of the CEO job
desc.zh: 子公司香港上市、双十一、支付宝争议、回购雅虎持股，以及交出 CEO 一职

t.en: Global icon
t.zh: 全球偶像

desc.en: The record New York IPO makes him China's best-known businessman; he retires as chairman at 55
desc.zh: 创纪录的纽约上市让他成为中国最知名的企业家；55 岁卸任董事局主席

t.en: The reckoning
t.zh: 风暴之后

desc.en: A speech in Shanghai, the halted Ant IPO, a record antitrust fine and a long retreat from public view
desc.zh: 上海的一场演讲、被叫停的蚂蚁上市、创纪录的反垄断罚单，以及长时间淡出公众视野

t.en: Quiet return
t.zh: 低调归来

desc.en: Back in China without a formal post, he reappears beside the country's leaders while Alibaba bets on AI
desc.zh: 回到国内但不任正式职务，重新出现在最高领导层出席的场合，阿里巴巴则押注 AI

t.en: Born in Hangzhou, Zhejiang
t.zh: 出生于浙江杭州

summary.en: Ma Yun, later known abroad as Jack Ma, was born in Hangzhou, the capital of Zhejiang province. As a boy he practised English by talking with foreign visitors to the city.
summary.zh: 马云出生在浙江省会杭州。少年时代，他靠和来杭州的外国游客聊天练习英语。

why.en: Starting point, not scored. Human capital begins far below the rich-country level used for other people in the model, because he was born in 1960s China; the figure is an estimate.
why.zh: 起点事件，不计分。他出生在 1960 年代的中国，人力资本的初始值远低于模型里发达国家人物的水平，数值为估算。

src.name: Wikipedia · Jack Ma

t.en: Fails the college entrance exam, then fails again a year later
t.zh: 第一次高考落榜，次年再次落榜

summary.en: He sat China's national college entrance exam in 1982 and failed, with a very low mathematics score. He tried again in 1983 and failed a second time.
summary.zh: 1982 年他第一次参加高考，数学分数极低而落榜；1983 年再考，仍然没有考上。

why.en: A small negative step at the time. He later told the story so often that it became part of his public image, but the model does not score that in advance. Only the year is known, so the date is year precision.
why.zh: 在当时是一次小挫折。这段经历后来被他反复讲述，成了个人形象的一部分，但模型不会提前计分。只能确认年份，因此日期精度为“年”。

src.name: Wikipedia · Jack Ma

t.en: Admitted to Hangzhou Normal University on his third attempt
t.zh: 第三次高考后进入杭州师范学院

summary.en: On his third try he was admitted to the English department of Hangzhou Normal University (then Hangzhou Teachers College), after the department did not fill its places.
summary.zh: 第三次高考后，他被杭州师范学院（今杭州师范大学）英语系录取，当时该系没有招满。

why.en: An education step: the human-capital target rises with a place at university, which was rare in China in the 1980s.
why.zh: 学历台阶：在 1980 年代的中国，上大学的机会很少，人力资本目标值随之上调。

src.name: Wikipedia · Jack Ma

t.en: Graduates and becomes an English lecturer in Hangzhou
t.zh: 大学毕业，在杭州当英语教师

summary.en: He graduated with a bachelor's degree in English in 1988 and took a job teaching English at what is now Hangzhou Dianzi University. In 1994 he also started a small translation agency.
summary.zh: 1988 年他获得英语专业学士学位，到杭州电子工业学院（今杭州电子科技大学）教英语。1994 年，他还办了一家小型翻译社。

why.en: First job and first salary. Human capital rises slightly and a small savings anchor starts here (estimate).
why.zh: 第一份工作、第一份工资。人力资本小幅上升，模型从这里开始设置一个很小的积蓄锚点（估算）。

src.name: Wikipedia · Jack Ma

t.en: Sees the internet in the United States and starts China Pages
t.zh: 在美国第一次接触互联网，回国创办中国黄页

summary.en: In early 1995 he travelled to the United States on behalf of the Hangzhou city government and used the internet for the first time. Back home, in April, he opened a company that ran China Pages, one of the country's first commercial websites, listing Chinese businesses online.
summary.zh: 1995 年初，他受杭州市政府委托赴美，第一次接触互联网。回国后，他在 4 月开办公司，运营中国最早的商业网站之一“中国黄页”，把中国企业的信息搬到网上。

why.en: His first internet venture. It stayed small, so the money effect is minor, but it is where the idea for Alibaba came from. Reputation coefficient +1%.
why.zh: 他的第一次互联网创业。规模一直不大，金额影响很小，但阿里巴巴的想法由此而来。口碑系数 +1%。

src.name: Wikipedia · Jack Ma

t.en: Runs an e-commerce unit under the foreign trade ministry in Beijing
t.zh: 在北京主持外经贸部下属的电子商务公司

summary.en: After leaving China Pages he moved to Beijing and, from 1998 to 1999, headed an IT company set up by the China International Electronic Commerce Center, an arm of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation.
summary.zh: 离开中国黄页后，他去了北京，1998 至 1999 年主持由外经贸部下属中国国际电子商务中心设立的一家信息技术公司。

why.en: A salaried job inside a government body. No score; it matters as the experience he walked away from to start Alibaba.
why.zh: 体制内的一份受薪工作，不计分。它的意义在于：他正是放弃这份工作回杭州创办了阿里巴巴。

src.name: Wikipedia · Jack Ma

t.en: Founds Alibaba in Hangzhou with 17 co-founders
t.zh: 与 17 位伙伴在杭州创办阿里巴巴

summary.en: He returned to Hangzhou and, with 17 friends and former students, started Alibaba.com, a website that connected Chinese exporters with buyers abroad. The group is known in China as the "18 founders". The team began work in his apartment earlier in the year; June 28, 1999 is the date the holding company was formed.
summary.zh: 他回到杭州，和 17 位朋友、学生一起创办阿里巴巴网站，帮中国的出口企业对接海外买家，这批人后来被称为“十八罗汉”。团队当年早些时候就在他的公寓里开工，1999 年 6 月 28 日是控股公司成立的日期。

why.en: The turning point of his life: from here he holds founder equity. Financial capital switches from savings to an estimated stake value, and human capital starts climbing toward the level of a startup founder.
why.zh: 人生转折点：从这里起他持有创始人股权。金融资本从积蓄切换为估算的股权价值，人力资本开始向“创业公司创始人”的水平爬升。

fin.en: Founder equity enters the model (private-stage values are estimates interpolated between funding events).
fin.zh: 创始人股权进入模型（私有阶段的价值为估算，按各次融资事件插值）。

src.name: Wikipedia · Alibaba Group
SEC EDGAR · Alibaba IPO prospectus (424B4)
Wikipedia · Jack Ma

t.en: Goldman Sachs leads a first outside round of about $5 million
t.zh: 高盛领投第一轮外部融资，约 500 万美元

summary.en: A group of investors led by Goldman Sachs put about $5 million into the months-old company. It was Alibaba's first institutional money.
summary.zh: 由高盛领投的一批投资者向这家成立仅几个月的公司投入约 500 万美元，这是阿里巴巴拿到的第一笔机构资金。

why.en: First priced round. The stake anchor rises to about $2 million; the valuation and his ownership share at the time are not public, so this is a rough estimate.
why.zh: 第一轮有定价的融资。持股价值锚点上调到约 200 万美元；当时的估值和他的持股比例没有公开，这是粗略估算。

fin.zh: 估算持股价值：约 200 万美元。

src.name: The Globe and Mail · How Goldman Sachs won and lost with Alibaba
Wikipedia · Jack Ma

t.en: SoftBank invests $20 million
t.zh: 软银投资 2000 万美元

summary.en: Masayoshi Son's SoftBank invested $20 million in Alibaba shortly before the dot-com crash. The money carried the company through the lean years that followed, and SoftBank was its largest shareholder at the time of the 2014 listing.
summary.zh: 孙正义的软银在互联网泡沫破裂前不久向阿里巴巴投资 2000 万美元。这笔钱帮公司熬过了随后的寒冬；到 2014 年上市时，软银是第一大股东。

why.en: The stake anchor rises to about $8 million (estimate). The backing of a well-known investor also lifts human capital toward the funded-founder level.
why.zh: 持股价值锚点上调到约 800 万美元（估算）。有知名投资人背书，人力资本也向“获得融资的创始人”水平靠拢。

fin.zh: 估算持股价值：约 800 万美元。

src.name: TechNode · Alibaba's biggest stockholder invested in the company in 1999
Wikipedia · Jack Ma

t.en: Launches Taobao to take on eBay in China
t.zh: 推出淘宝，在中国迎战 eBay

summary.en: Alibaba launched Taobao, a marketplace where individuals and small shops sell to consumers. It came out the same year eBay bought EachNet, then China's leading auction site, for $180 million. Taobao charged sellers no listing fees.
summary.zh: 阿里巴巴推出面向个人卖家和小店铺的购物平台淘宝。同一年，eBay 以 1.8 亿美元收购了当时中国最大的拍卖网站易趣。淘宝不向卖家收取上架费。

why.en: The product that turned Alibaba from an export directory into China's main consumer marketplace. The value shows up in later funding rounds; the reputation coefficient gets +2% for taking on a much larger rival.
why.zh: 这款产品让阿里巴巴从外贸信息平台变成中国最主要的消费电商。价值体现在之后的融资估值里；敢于挑战体量大得多的对手，口碑系数 +2%。

src.name: Wikipedia · Taobao

t.en: Alipay is set up as Alibaba's payment arm
t.zh: 支付宝成立，成为阿里巴巴的支付业务

summary.en: Alibaba set up Alipay as a payment service that holds a buyer's money until the goods arrive. It solved the lack of trust between strangers trading online and later grew into Ant Group.
summary.zh: 阿里巴巴成立支付宝，由它先替买家保管货款，收到货后再付给卖家。这解决了网上陌生人交易缺乏信任的问题，后来发展为蚂蚁集团。

why.en: At this stage Alipay sat inside Alibaba, so its value is part of the Alibaba stake. Only the year is firmly sourced, so the date is year precision. Reputation coefficient +2%.
why.zh: 这一阶段支付宝属于阿里巴巴内部业务，价值包含在阿里巴巴股权里。只能确认年份，因此日期精度为“年”。口碑系数 +2%。

src.name: Wikipedia · Ant Group
Wikipedia · Alipay

t.en: Yahoo pays $1 billion and hands over Yahoo China for about 40% of Alibaba
t.zh: 雅虎以 10 亿美元加雅虎中国换取阿里巴巴约 40% 股份

summary.en: Yahoo agreed to invest $1 billion in cash and to fold its China business into Alibaba in exchange for a stake of about 40%. The deal made Yahoo the largest shareholder.
summary.zh: 雅虎同意投入 10 亿美元现金，并把雅虎中国的业务并入阿里巴巴，换取约 40% 的股份。交易完成后雅虎成为第一大股东。

why.en: The deal implied a value of roughly $4 billion for Alibaba. The stake anchor rises to about $350 million, assuming he held a little under 10%; that share is an estimate.
why.zh: 这笔交易对应阿里巴巴约 40 亿美元的估值。持股价值锚点上调到约 3.5 亿美元，假设他当时持股略低于 10%，该比例为估算。

fin.zh: 估算持股价值：约 3.5 亿美元。

src.name: Al Jazeera · Yahoo to invest $1 billion in China firm (2005-08-11)
Wikipedia · Alibaba Group

t.en: eBay gives up running its own site in China
t.zh: eBay 放弃在中国独立运营

summary.en: eBay announced it would fold its China business into a joint venture controlled by Tom Online, ending its stand-alone operation in the country. Between 2003 and 2005 Taobao's share of the market had risen from 8% to 59% while eBay's fell from 79% to 36%.
summary.zh: eBay 宣布把中国业务并入由 TOM 在线控股的合资公司，结束在中国的独立运营。2003 至 2005 年间，淘宝的市场份额从 8% 升到 59%，eBay 则从 79% 跌到 36%。

why.en: No money changed hands for him, but beating eBay made his name in China and abroad. Reputation coefficient +3%.
why.zh: 他本人没有任何资金进出，但击败 eBay 让他在国内外成名。口碑系数 +3%。

src.name: InfoWorld · Foreign Internet firms struggle in China
Wikipedia · Taobao

t.en: Alibaba.com, the trade-site subsidiary, lists in Hong Kong
t.zh: 旗下 B2B 子公司阿里巴巴网络在香港上市

summary.en: The business-to-business subsidiary Alibaba.com raised about $1.5 billion in Hong Kong, the largest internet offering since Google's. The shares nearly tripled on the first day, November 6, and then fell back sharply over the following year. The parent group stayed private.
summary.zh: 集团旗下的 B2B 子公司阿里巴巴网络在香港上市，募资约 15 亿美元，是谷歌之后规模最大的互联网 IPO。11 月 6 日上市首日股价接近发行价的三倍，随后一年大幅回落。母公司阿里巴巴集团仍未上市。

why.en: Only a subsidiary was listed, so the model keeps his wealth in the private anchor: about $1.5 billion at the peak and lower in 2008 (estimates). The subsidiary was taken private again in 2012.
why.zh: 上市的只是子公司，所以模型仍用私有锚点记录他的财富：高点约 15 亿美元，2008 年回落（均为估算）。该子公司在 2012 年被私有化。

fin.en: Estimated stake in the group: about $1.5 billion at the peak.
fin.zh: 估算的集团持股价值：高点约 15 亿美元。

src.name: Al Jazeera · China's Alibaba soars in HK debut (2007-11-06)
Wikipedia · Alibaba Group

t.en: The first Singles' Day sale
t.zh: 第一届“双十一”促销

summary.en: Alibaba's Taobao Mall held a one-day discount sale on November 11, an unofficial holiday for single people. Sales were about 50 million yuan that day. By 2014 the event brought in about $9 billion in a day and had become the world's largest shopping event.
summary.zh: 淘宝商城在 11 月 11 日“光棍节”这天做了一次全天打折促销，当天成交额约 5000 万元。到 2014 年，这一天的成交额约 90 亿美元，成为全球最大的购物节。

why.en: The idea is credited to Daniel Zhang, who later succeeded him, so the score for Ma is small: +1%. The commercial value is in the Alibaba stake.
why.zh: 这个点子归功于后来接替他的张勇，所以给马云的分数很小：+1%。商业价值已包含在阿里巴巴股权里。

src.name: Wikipedia · Singles' Day
Wikipedia · Taobao

t.en: Yahoo discloses that Alipay was moved out of Alibaba
t.zh: 雅虎披露支付宝已被转出阿里巴巴

summary.en: Yahoo disclosed that ownership of Alipay had been transferred from Alibaba Group to a Chinese company controlled by Ma, and said the board and shareholders had not approved it. Ma said the board had been informed and that the change was needed to obtain a Chinese payment licence. On July 29, 2011 Alibaba, Yahoo and SoftBank settled: Alibaba would share in Alipay's profits and receive a payment, reported as 37.5% of Alipay's equity value, at a future IPO or sale.
summary.zh: 雅虎披露，支付宝的所有权已从阿里巴巴集团转到马云控制的一家中国公司，并称此举未经董事会和股东批准。马云表示董事会知情，这样做是为了取得中国的支付牌照。2011 年 7 月 29 日，阿里巴巴、雅虎和软银达成协议：阿里巴巴继续分享支付宝的利润，并在支付宝未来上市或出售时获得一笔补偿，据报道为其股权价值的 37.5%。

why.en: The two sides gave different accounts and the model takes no side. The dispute hurt his standing with foreign investors for a time, so the reputation coefficient takes -3%. From here the model tracks his interest in the payment business as a separate private holding, starting small (estimate).
why.zh: 双方说法不一，模型不作判断。这场争议一度损害了他在海外投资者中的信誉，口碑系数 -3%。模型从这里起把他在支付业务中的权益单独列为一项私有资产，起始值很小（估算）。

src.name: SEC EDGAR · Yahoo press release on the Alipay agreement (8-K exhibit, 2011-07-29)
PCWorld · Alibaba transferred Alipay ownership without Yahoo approval

t.en: Alibaba buys back about half of Yahoo's stake for $7.6 billion
t.zh: 阿里巴巴以 76 亿美元回购雅虎约一半持股

summary.en: Alibaba completed the repurchase of 523 million of its shares from Yahoo at about $13.54 each, roughly $7.1 billion, plus a $550 million licence payment. Yahoo was left with about 23%. Earlier in the year the group had also taken the Hong Kong-listed Alibaba.com private.
summary.zh: 阿里巴巴完成向雅虎回购 5.23 亿股，每股约 13.54 美元，合计约 71 亿美元，另付 5.5 亿美元技术许可费。交易后雅虎持股约 23%。同年早些时候，集团还把香港上市的阿里巴巴网络私有化。

why.en: The buyback price put a firm value on Alibaba shares. At $13.54 his roughly 206 million shares were worth about $2.8 billion (the share count is taken from the 2014 prospectus and applied backwards, so it is an estimate).
why.zh: 回购价给阿里巴巴股份定了一个明确的价格。按每股 13.54 美元计算，他约 2.06 亿股价值约 28 亿美元（股数取自 2014 年招股书并向前套用，属于估算）。

fin.zh: 估算持股价值：约 28 亿美元。

src.name: SEC EDGAR · Yahoo press release on the share repurchase (8-K exhibit, 2012-09-18)
The Next Web · Alibaba completes initial $7.6 billion share repurchase

t.en: Hands the CEO job to Jonathan Lu and stays on as executive chairman
t.zh: 把 CEO 交给陆兆禧，自己留任董事局主席

summary.en: At the age of 48 he gave up the chief executive post, saying younger colleagues should run the company day to day. Jonathan Lu took over, and Ma remained executive chairman.
summary.zh: 48 岁的他卸任首席执行官，表示日常经营应交给更年轻的同事。陆兆禧接任，马云继续担任董事局主席。

why.en: Scored as neutral: he kept control as chairman and through the Alibaba Partnership. A small +1% for an orderly handover.
why.zh: 记为中性：他以主席身份并通过阿里巴巴合伙人制度继续掌握控制权。交接有序，口碑系数小幅 +1%。

src.name: Wikipedia · Jack Ma

t.en: Alibaba lists in New York in the largest IPO on record
t.zh: 阿里巴巴在纽约上市，创下全球最大 IPO 纪录

summary.en: Alibaba priced its shares at $68 and raised about $25 billion including the over-allotment, the largest IPO in history at the time. The stock closed its first day at $93.89, up 38%. Ma sold a small part of his holding in the offering and owned about 7.8% afterwards, which made him the richest person in China.
summary.zh: 阿里巴巴以每股 68 美元定价，连同超额配售共募资约 250 亿美元，是当时史上最大的 IPO。首日收于 93.89 美元，上涨 38%。马云在发行中出售了少量股份，上市后持股约 7.8%，成为中国首富。

why.en: Anchor switch: from this day financial capital = ownership × shares outstanding × the daily close. About 192 million shares at the $68 offer price were worth $13.1 billion. Reputation coefficient +4% for a listing that made him known worldwide.
why.zh: 锚点切换：从这一天起，金融资本 = 持股比例 × 总股本 × 当日收盘价。约 1.92 亿股按 68 美元发行价计算约值 131 亿美元。这次上市让他闻名全球，口碑系数 +4%。

fin.en: Priced daily from the BABA quote from here on (share counts are in ADS terms; one ADS is now eight ordinary shares).
fin.zh: 此后按 BABA 日线逐日计价（股本按 ADS 口径计算，目前 1 份 ADS 对应 8 股普通股）。

src.name: SEC EDGAR · Alibaba IPO prospectus (424B4)
Wikipedia · Alibaba Group
Yahoo Finance · BABA price history

t.en: Meets President-elect Donald Trump at Trump Tower

why.en: Recorded as reported, since the company has not confirmed it. If accurate, it means his judgment is again shaping a large public company, so the human-capital target rises a little and the reputation coefficient gets +2%. t.en: Alibaba sells HK$80 billion of new shares for AI; Ma is reported to buy stock
t.zh: 阿里巴巴配股 800 亿港元投向 AI，据报马云出手增持

summary.en: Alibaba placed 710 million new Hong Kong shares at HK$112.70 each, raising HK$80 billion, about $10.2 billion, for AI chips, infrastructure and models. It was the largest primary follow-on offering by a Hong Kong-listed company and was priced 8.4% below the previous close. The Hong Kong shares fell more than 8% on August 24. Caixin and the South China Morning Post, citing sources, reported that Ma bought more than HK$600 million of shares after the announcement; Joe Tsai and Eddie Wu disclosed smaller purchases.
summary.zh: 阿里巴巴以每股 112.70 港元配售 7.1 亿股香港新股，募资 800 亿港元，约合 102 亿美元，用于 AI 芯片、基础设施和模型。这是香港上市公司史上最大规模的新股配售，配售价较前一交易日收盘价折让 8.4%。8 月 24 日港股下跌超过 8%。财新和《南华早报》援引消息人士报道，马云在公告后买入超过 6 亿港元的股票；蔡崇信和吴泳铭披露了金额较小的增持。

why.en: The new shares are about 3.6% of the enlarged share count, which slightly dilutes every holder; the share and ownership anchors reflect that. His reported purchase, about $77 million, is small next to his holding and comes from sources, not from a filing. The price effect is in the stock, so rep = 0.
why.zh: 新股约占扩大后股本的 3.6%，所有股东的持股比例都被小幅稀释，股本和持股锚点已反映。据报道他买入约 7700 万美元，相对其持股规模很小，而且消息来自知情人士而非监管文件。价格影响已在股价里，rep = 0。
